candidate_parameter.name: park_home_run_alpha
candidate_parameter.application: apply the same alpha to handedness-specific and overall Savant HR park factors in both I1 state generation and direct-I2 event vectors

selection_rule.parsimony_rule: if candidate alphas are statistically indistinguishable under paired calendar-date uncertainty, choose the alpha closest to 1.0 rather than the most aggressively shrunk value
selection_rule.no_2025_or_2026_selection: 2025 and 2026 may not change the selected alpha

validation_rule.2025: after alpha is frozen, test once; reject promotion if paired calendar-date evidence shows credible degradation versus alpha=1.0
validation_rule.2026: replication only; reject promotion if it reveals credible adverse reversal
validation_rule.promotion: requires development advantage plus no credible degradation in either frozen validation stage; otherwise retain current HR factor

reason: Park HR is the largest unresolved variable-level instability. Full removal improves pooled 2022-2025 but worsens 2026, so choosing shrinkage after seeing 2026 would overfit. This precommit prevents that.
